summary: Optimi Health Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing it has secured ibogaine supply and commenced finished drug product development. The filing discusses the company's ibogaine initiative, GMP facility capabilities, regulatory framework, and plans for manufacturing encapsulated dosages. There are no deal terms, no acquisition/divestiture tender, no activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is a routine business update regarding product development and supply.
